failure_dispositions.engine_unhealthy: remove redirect before stopping or restarting the engine
failure_dispositions.watchdog_unhealthy: stop renewing the kernel-expiring lease; active stop also removes redirect
failure_dispositions.geo_invalid_or_unavailable: forward the verified original response without modification
failure_dispositions.protocol_unknown_or_invalid: forward the verified original response without modification
failure_dispositions.upstream_tls_invalid: controlled failure; never disable certificate verification

resource_limits: handshake, upstream, read, and idle timeouts

critical_high_threats.control: verify the Apple upstream chain, validity, SNI and hostname
bind interception to one assigned device and reject binding drift
use exact DNS sets and a second exact hostname check
use only the dedicated WLOC table and keep Gateway state read-only
patch only an authorized known protocol and otherwise preserve original bytes
critical_high_threats.evidence: fixture round-trip, unknown-version and malformed-input tests

critical_high_threats.control: validate Geo schema, ranges, exit binding and expiry
critical_high_threats.evidence: invalid, conflicting, stale and wrong-exit Geo tests

critical_high_threats.control: keep CA and leaf private keys router-local with mode 0600
critical_high_threats.evidence: permission, backup, support-bundle and repository scans

critical_high_threats.control: exclude node credentials and provider tokens from logs and artifacts
critical_high_threats.evidence: canary scans over error and crash outputs
normal, debug, error, crash and rotation privacy tests

critical_high_threats.control: bound wire, decoded, decompressed and parser work before allocation
bound TLS and H2 connections, streams, queues and timeouts
critical_high_threats.evidence: slow-client, stream-flood, RST and GOAWAY tests

critical_high_threats.control: gate redirect matches on a kernel-expiring lease renewed only while engine, scope and IPv6 are healthy

critical_high_threats.control: require an approved IPv6 mode before redirect
